Power Apps interface

extracted data, approve or reject it, after which it was forwarded to the finance team for

final processing.

Technologies: Power Apps, Power Automate and Azure AI Foundry

approver) and implemented reminders for any outstanding approvals.

Once all approvers approved, the system generated a PDF and sent it to the uploader; if any

approver rejected, the uploader received an email with comments.

Power Apps, Power Automate, Power Virtual Agents, Dataverse and AI-Builder.

Created 120 Power Automate Cloud Flows,10 PowerApps Canvas Application, 2 Model

Driven Apps, 8 Power BI Dashboards and 2 Power Virtual Agent Chatbot.

Technologies: PowerApps and Power Automate

Project Description:

This Power App allows monthly recognition of associates by their managers, with each

manager limited to one vote per associate per month.

A Power Automate Flow captures responses from a Nomination Microsoft Form and inserts

them into a SharePoint list for managers to vote for their associates.

Technologies: Power BI, PowerApps, Power Automate and Dataverse

Project Description:

This Power App allows monthly recognition of associates by their managers, with each

manager limited to one vote per associate per month.
